description.content:
## General
Upload a document for any Road Shipment.


### Accepted Document Types
PDF, TIFF, JPEG, DOCX, XLSX, etc


:::tip[Document Extension]
Do not include the period [ . ] in the document extension in the JSON request. 
:::

### Accepted Document Codes
| DocumentCode | Document Description                   |
|:----------:|----------------------------------------|
| 0.03     | Quality inspection cert                |
| 0.11     | Temperature timetable                  |
| 0.12     | Temperature readout                    |
| 0.53     | Safety data sheet                      |
| 105      | Purchase order                         |
| 131      | Declaration of Undertaking             |
| 167      | Carta Porte                            |
| 171      | pick up notice                         |
| 260      | Certificate of Conformity              |
| 263      | Certificate of Analysis                |
| 270      | Delivery note                          |
| 271      | Packing list                           |
| 325      | Proforma invoice                       |
| 340      | Shipper/vendor docs                    |
| 342      | Export cargo instructions              |
| 351      | Notice of shipment                     |
| 380      | Commercial invoice                     |
| 387      | Temperature readout                    |
| 388      | Temp readout depot                     |
| 390      | DG Declaration                         |
| 510      | Client documents                       |
| 515      | Pallet list out signed                 |
| 516      | Transport order signed                 |
| 517      | CMR                                    |
| 521      | Delivery Note                          |
| 522      | Driver delivery manifest signed        |
| 523      | Consignment note signed                |
| 546      | Subsequent POD with differences        |
| 630      | Shipping order                         |
| 640      | Delivery order                         |
| 707      | Bill of lading copy                    |
| 821      | Despatch note T1                       |
| 825      | Transit accompany doc                  |
| 833      | Export declaration                     |
| 860      | Certificate of Origin                  |
| 929      | Customs entry                          |
| 944      | Customs documents                      |
| 953      | Eur1                                   |
| 990      | Power of Attorney                      |
| 913      | Customs declaration                    |
